subject: research-verification/source-awareness
statement: Research verification must surface a contextual warning when the current task has no recorded source provenance or evidence before sourcing is attested PASS. The warning is advisory rather than a universal hard block.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Implement R6.2 Cognitive Hardening from fresh-model dogfood: cross-task context relevance, research source awareness, and material open-question awareness.
